meta.comment: PLACEHOLDER starter item catalog created to exercise the InventorySystem (ROADMAP Phase 2 — Inventory (basic)). Every item follows the data-driven contract from DESIGN.md 'Items & Economy': id, name, description, grade, quality, value, tags, stackSize, icon and optional category. Grade uses the 11-tier scale (Mortal..Chaos) and quality the 7-tier scale (Broken..Legendary). Real item content and balancing are authored during the Items & Economy phase. Icon assets are not authored yet, so the icon field is an empty-string placeholder.
